[IERR.2.7.1] These come from the integrator's typed callback
returning an error code; libds propagates verbatim.
Storage backends are integrator territory ([IARC.2.3]);
network-layer failures live inside the integrator's
callback and are translated to one of these codes if
they want libds's storage-error path, or to a custom
`DS_ERR_*` code the integrator picks.
